title: The Kensington Runestone
hook: Who carved the mysterious Viking stone in Minnesota?
headline: Viking inscription that baffled scholars

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1898, Swedish immigrant Olof Ohman discovered a stone near the small town of Kensington.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The inscription is dated to 1362 but does not mention Erik the Red.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Linguists note the runes diverge from those used in the 14th century, not the 13th.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2004, a geochemical test suggested the stone's surface was artificially aged.

end.line: Could Vikings really have reached Minnesota centuries early?

description: Explore the mysterious Kensington Runestone and the debate over its origins.
